plugin.name: memlens
plugin.description: Reverse engineer a Linux kernel from a memory image: exports kernel and modules as a symbolled ELF at their live addresses, imports every kernel type from a Volatility ISF, and lists hooked kernel functions and who hooked them (ftrace or module callback, BPF program or kprobe). IDA layer tested with fake IDA modules only, not yet run in a real IDA.
